title: Migrate Go CSV util from io/ioutil to os package
description: The go_csv_reader package uses the deprecated io/ioutil package for file I/O in internal/csvutil/csvutil.go. Migrate to modern os.ReadFile and os.WriteFile.

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate internal/csvutil/csvutil.go from the deprecated io/ioutil package to modern equivalents.

Replacements:
  ioutil.ReadFile(path)  ->  os.ReadFile(path)
  ioutil.WriteFile(path, data, perm)  ->  os.WriteFile(path, data, perm)

Remove the 'io/ioutil' import and add 'os' if not already present.
Remove all //nolint:staticcheck comments.
All existing tests must pass without modification.

Run go test ./... to confirm.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to verify the migration is correct. Make sure existing behavior is preserved and the migration handles edge cases safely.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm all tests pass. Is this migration safe to run on real data without data loss or breaking existing clients?
